name: Kairos Health
long_description:
Kairos Health automates patient engagement for dentists by handling phones and insurance.

Kairos plugs into a dental practice's software, calls patients who are overdue for care, and books them directly into the schedule. It also answers every inbound call 24/7 and verifies insurance.

Our mission is to put practice operations on autopilot and keep every chair filled.
one_liner: AI front desk that fills every chair for dental practices
